ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.

2. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

3. When learning Direct Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Direct Current Motors.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Direct Current Motors.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Direct Current Motors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Direct Current Motors.

4. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.

5. When learning Single phase Alternating Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

7. When learning Project Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Implementation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Implementation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project Implementation.

8. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

12. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Current Motors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Single phase Alternating Current Motors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Single-Phase alternating current Transformers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
